title: Big Bold Fruity Blackcurrant 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Big Bold Fruity Shortfill Blackcurrant delivers a burst of rich and tangy blackcurrant flavour with every inhale. This intense berry blend is perfect for vapers who love bold, juicy fruit flavours that provide a satisfying and refreshing vape experience. The Big Bold Shortfill range is blended with a 70% VG / 30% PG ratio, making it ideal for sub-ohm vaping and high-powered vape kits. Each 100ml bottle comes with 20ml of extra space for the addition of two nicotine shots to tailor your e-liquid's strength to your preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. If you're a fan of tropical flavours, there are several other exciting blends to discover in Big Bold’s Fruity collection, including Blackcurrant, Honey Melon, and Lemon Lime. Explore the world of Big Bold and enjoy the perfect balance of flavour and vapour production with every puff.
